description_html:
The Samsung 30Q 18650 Battery is a high-drain rechargeable battery for box mods and regulated vape devices. Reliable performance with 3000mAh capacity and 15A continuous discharge.

  • Product Type: Rechargeable Battery
  • Battery Size: 18650
  • Capacity: 3000mAh
  • Terminal Type: Flat Top
  • Chemistry: Li-ion
  • Nominal Voltage: 3.6V
  • Max Continuous Discharge: 15A
  • Compatible Devices: Any regulated mod requiring a single or dual 18650 battery (e.g., VOOPOO DRAG, Vaporesso GEN series, and similar box mods)
  • Brand: Samsung

Always use battery safety best practices. Never carry loose batteries - use a battery case. Do not use damaged or re-wrapped batteries. Charge only with a dedicated external battery charger.
